candidate.name: Ignacio Arsuaga
candidate.startAvailability: Target start availability: late August to early September 2026, subject to USCIS approval and EAD issuance

hero.label: Made for Canonical
hero.headline: I'm eager to drive growth at Canonical using my sales expertise.
hero.subheadline: I'm thrilled about Canonical's innovative approach to open-source technologies and their collaboration with industry giants. As an SDR, I can't wait to contribute by identifying strategic opportunities and amplifying Canonical's impact in global markets.

whyCompany.title: Canonical's leadership in open-source innovation
whyCompany.body: Canonical is at the forefront of open-source solutions, driving change across cloud and IoT landscapes. Their partnerships with leaders like Google and Microsoft highlight their pivotal role in technological advancement.

whyCompany.title: Dynamic growth and global influence
whyCompany.body: Canonical is in a unique growth phase, expanding rapidly in the global tech ecosystem. This moment offers an incredible opportunity to join a team that shapes how businesses adopt emerging technologies.

whyCompany.title: Aligning BDR skills with Canonical's sales vision
whyCompany.body: Having honed my BDR skills at Copygen.ai, I bring experience in client acquisition and strategic outreach. At Canonical, I'm excited to leverage these skills in a role focused on driving impactful sales campaigns.

quote: Joining Canonical as an SDR allows me to blend my passion for tech with my sales acumen. I envision great growth and learning.
